question: The sum of two numbers is 45 and their difference is 13. Find the smaller number.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Smaller number = (Sum − Difference) ÷ 2

⇒ Smaller number = (45 − 13) ÷ 2

⇒ Smaller number = 32 ÷ 2 = 16

**∴ The correct answer is 16.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sum of the two numbers = 45

Difference of the two numbers = 13

**Formula Used:**

x + y = Sum

x − y = Difference
